Meet RDT2 — the first foundation model that zero-shot deploys on any robot arm
tweets.body:
🤬💢😵‍💫 Tired of endless data collection & fine-tuning every time you deploy VLAs?

Meet RDT2 — the first foundation model that zero-shot deploys on any robot arms! (w/o collection & fine-tuning)

We collected 10K+ hours of UMI data in 100+ real-world houses for pretraining, at 1/10 cost and 5x speed of teleoperation

Just plug and play🚀 Generalizes to unseen scenes, objects & instructions.

More info:
- Redesigned UMI @chichengcc @SongShuran hardware with high-strength materials and precise tracking methods
- 7B VLA with diffusion expert distilled to one-step → 23 Hz inference⚡
- Zero-shot: pick, place, press, wipe… open-vocabulary
- Demos: block 30 m/s arrows in 500 ms🛡️; First to play ping-pong with one end-to-end model🏓; extinguish burning incense by shaking quickly🥢...

Fully open source at https://t.co/juzBEY49ex 
Project page: https://t.co/z8ce3szXPU

tweets.title:
😠💢😵‍💫Tired of endless data collection & fine-tuning every time you try out VLA?

Meet RDT2, the first foundation model that zero-shot deploys on any robot arms
tweets.body:
😠💢😵‍💫Tired of endless data collection & fine-tuning every time you try out VLA?

Meet RDT2, the first foundation model that zero-shot deploys on any robot arms with unseen scenes, objects & instructions.

No collection. No tuning. Just plug and play🚀

Witness a clear sign of embodied superintelligence

- 7B one-step diffusion → 23 Hz inference⚡
- Re-designed UMI @chichengcc @SongShuran and manufactured 100 portable devices
- Trained on 10K-hour UMI data on 100 real houses
- Zero-shot: pick, place, press, wipe… open-vocabulary
- Demos: block 30 m/s arrows in 500 ms🛡️; first to play ping-pong with an end-to-end model 🏓; extinguish burning incense by shaking quickly🥢

Fully open source at https://t.co/juzBEY4H45
Project page: https://t.co/z8ce3sAvFs

Thanks to awesome collaborators @bang_guo96535 @D0g4M74794 @EthanNg51931527
